# Washington Wizards 2026/27 Season Preview: What You Need To Know!

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-07-23, 38:21. https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Ben Strobe of Locked On Wizards preview the Washington Wizards for 2026/27. They say the rebuild is over: Washington added Trae Young and Anthony Davis last season, drafted AJ Dybantsa first overall, traded Jaden Hardy for Deandre Ayton and brought back Khris Middleton. Ben's projected starting five is Young, Kyshawn George, Dybantsa, Davis and Alex Sarr. He calls George the organization's favorite young wing, says Young will still run the offense, and is very high on Sarr, who is coming back from a fractured foot. Defense is the big question, with Steve Clifford joining the coaching staff. Ben predicts about 40 wins and a play-in spot. For fantasy, the main takeaway is that the Wizards should no longer rest players or cut their minutes like a tanking team, so their players are easier to trust.

## Rules and methods

- [36:36](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2196) Players on a team that is trying to win are easier to trust in fantasy than players on a tanking team. Tanking teams pull players after three quarters and sit them for much of March.
  > "we don't have that, oh my god, are they going to get you pulled after three quarters"
- [18:12](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1092) Be careful with late-season (March) stats from rebuilding teams. They are hard to trust.
  > "it's March basketball, so it's a little bit hard to buy stock in a lot of the things"
- [34:12](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2052) Rookies on deep teams may get limited minutes early in the season (around 28 instead of 34 a night). Do not expect big scoring nights right away.
  > "maybe he doesn't play 34 minutes maybe he's plays 28 minutes a night early on"
- [33:08](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1988) Summer league is for trial and error. Poor shooting there, like a 1-for-11 night from three, should not be overweighted.
  > "The three-point shot was not good, one for 11, but that's kind of what the summer league was for"
- [28:58](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1738) Seven-footers who have had foot injuries are a risk, because foot injuries can change the path of a big man's career.
  > "we know sevenfooters that have had foot injuries. uh it can can kind of change"
